task_description: Implement a Python CLI application (auto_openmatte) that automatically combines HDR 21:9 reference video with SDR 16:9 Open Matte video to produce a full 16:9 HDR output. The pipeline includes source inspection, image-based synchronization, shot detection, geometry alignment, luminance/color mapping, and composition. HDR is always the master - Open Matte is adapted to match HDR, never the reverse.
